context_requirements: A functional target of the myorelaxant class must be expressed; most myorelaxants act on ion channels, GABA-A receptors, or calcium-handling proteins not represented in the 978 landmark genes.
The cell line must have the relevant receptor/channel protein and downstream signaling machinery.
The drug must engage its target at 10 micromolar within 6-24 hours in a monolayer culture.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent change in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h that is shared across multiple myorelaxant drugs and absent with vehicle.
Enrichment of muscle-contraction or calcium-signaling gene sets among differentially expressed landmark genes.
Consistent upregulation of immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) or stress markers across cell lines.
